name: sync-claude-serve-docs
title: Sync CLAUDE serve examples with actual lattice serve options
description: CLAUDE.md still advertises npm run serve:web / npm run serve:cli and lattice serve --web / --cli, but lattice serve --help only exposes --dev and --port. We need to align the user-facing docs with the real CLI surface so the B-META-framework-audit findings F-012 and F-013 can close cleanly.
